stage1.objective: mean per-layer K/V normalized MSE in native pre-k_norm/pre-RoPE space; full-body tokens; sample-weighted accumulation

protocol: RAW Sender body without added BOS; fixed native Qwen public header only. Full-Sync maps every Receiver body token. Teacher raw Native K/V from k_proj/v_proj on header+same body. DRT raw output passes Qwen k_norm and RoPE exactly once. No Qwen body prefill in student evaluation.
selection: Fixed final epoch4 at each stage; validation diagnostic only; no test checkpoint selection.
launch_scope: User authorized full DRT implementation and two-stage matched training on server B.
caveats: Full-Sync guarantees shared synchronization-unit boundaries. Ordered Copy/Drop can select a source state whose end exceeds an individual target token end inside that unit. Audit and report intra-unit lookahead rather than claim strict per-token causality.

Static Memory is disabled for the initial independent-translator comparison. Existing Native/Recolor+C baselines use identical scoring and rows but historical training differs. Eight64-question cohorts, single seed exploratory; original labels and both GSM scorers retained.
DRT is a fresh model, not initialized from DST or Recolor+C. It uses input-dependent attention across Sender depth at each aligned token. Historical C differs in interface and training budget.
DRT and DST differ in architecture and parameter count (exact counts in manifest). No dynamic-vs-static routing ablation is scheduled.
